newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Paipote pay offer unattractive - union.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Paipote pay offer unattractive - union.

text.p: The final pay offer made this week by Enami, Chile's state copper company, during wage talks with workers at its Paipote smelter is not "appropriate," said Hector Cicardini, president of the plant's only union.
Enami has offered the plant's 500 workers a five year contract instead of a two-year deal workers had been demanding, Cicardini told Reuters by telephone from Paipote.
"The offer is not appropriate," said Cicardini.
The offer does not include a real wage increase, he said.
Workers will vote on the collective deal in a secret ballot Thursday.
Paipote, Chile's smallest copper smelter, was paralyzed by a week-long strike in 1994 after scheduled wage talks broke down.
The plant produces 68,000 tonnes of copper anodes a year.
